limitsOfIndependence: Same machine, same operating system and the same Node binary as the author's run; a toolchain-level fault common to both would not be detected.
The verifier read the author's code, protocol and outputs before rerunning; the rerun executes the author's code, it is not an independent reimplementation.
The verifier and the author are both Claude agents; the verifier did not see the author's reasoning, only the repository, the PR and the author's scratch outputs.
Score re-derivation and the RS T1 recount are independent code paths written by the verifier; HS T1 counting was not independently recounted by the verifier (R1 now does so).
Head d0fe56e was confirmed by the score phase and the A1/R1 checks only, not by a second full rerun.
